messages:
Alice Kim: Heads up 0 PeakFlow sent our renewal quote. There's a new 'express route' add-on and the embedding price jumped.
Sam Ortiz: ugh. can you paste the quote lines?
Alice Kim: pasted:
```
PeakFlow Renewal 2026
- Enterprise base: $23,000/mo
- Express route add-on: $4,200/mo
- Embedding unit: $0.0030 per embed (was $0.0020)
- Renewal discount: none quoted (term 12m)
```
Erin Zhao: I thought we had a 10% renewal credit last year. @billing-bot can you confirm committed ARR and last net invoice?
billing-bot: Contract PF-RED-2025: committed ARR $250,000; renewal credit 10% applied. Net invoiced (2025) = $225,000.
Sam Ortiz: Action: procurement to request reinstated discount or a 2yr price lock; finance to pull month-by-month embedding counts for last 6 months; ops to ask PeakFlow for the billing metric behind "express route".
Erin Zhao: Also request a 30-day pricing hold while we reconcile usage. If they insist on addon, ask for a 3-6 month trial or a credit.
Sam Ortiz: Draft email below, will send after review:
``
Subject: PeakFlow  renewal questions and pricing hold request

Hi PeakFlow team,

We received the renewal for PF-RED-2026 and have questions before we can proceed:
1) Please provide a line-item explanation for the new "express route" charge and the billing metric tied to it.
2) Please provide monthly embedding API usage for the last 6 months (counts per month) to validate overage calculations.
3) Confirm available renewal discounts for 12- or 24-month commitments and any migration/feature credits.
4) Please place the quoted pricing on a 30-day hold while we reconcile usage and contract terms.

If the addon is required, please propose a 3-month trial or equivalent credit while we evaluate.

Thanks,
Sam Ortiz
On behalf of Redwood Inference
```
Alice Kim: billing-bot please attach contract_PF-RED-2025.pdf and invoice_2025-12.pdf to our internal thread.
billing-bot: Attached: contract_PF-RED-2025.pdf, invoice_2025-12.pdf :white_check_mark:
Erin Zhao: Quick calc: listed annual with addon = (23,000 + 4,200) * 12 = $326,400. That's ~45% above our net last year ($225k). Not acceptable.
Alice Kim: Agreed. Negotiation targets: reinstate 10% + remove addon, or keep addon and give 20%+ discount across term.
Sam Ortiz: Sending now, cc procurement@redwood and finance. Will post their reply here when it comes in.
